summary: Cardiol Therapeutics Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Phase II MAvERIC study results on CardiolRx for recurrent pericarditis were published in the Journal of the American Heart Association. The filing describes clinical findings of rapid pain and inflammation reduction, and notes that the pivotal Phase III MAVERIC trial is nearing enrollment completion. There is no mention of any transaction, merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, restructuring, liquidation, or other special situation. This is a routine operational and scientific update from a biotech company.
